claims.claim: Nikon Zfc – retro-inspired, SLR-style mirrorless camera
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and 1 show 'Zfc' engraved on body with retro dial-based SLR-style design
Sensor specs cannot be confirmed from exterior photos; no spec screen or sensor shot provided
Photo 1 and 2 show lens barrel and cap marked 'TTArtisan APS-C 35mm F2.0'
Photo 2 shows Nikon rechargeable battery and matching charger

risks.risk: Unknown shutter count / overall mechanical wear
risks.proof: Screenshot of shutter count from camera menu or a sample test shot with visible EXIF/menu overlay
risks.if_unproven: priced as heavily used, worst-case mechanical wear

risks.risk: Sensor or autofocus faults not visible in static photos
risks.proof: Short video of camera powering on, autofocus locking on a subject, and a test image review
risks.if_unproven: priced as untested, assume possible AF/sensor fault

risks.proof: Close-up photo of front and rear lens elements under light
risks.if_unproven: priced as having visible optical flaws

risks.risk: No kit/native Nikon Z lens included, only third-party TTArtisan lens
risks.proof: Photo or explicit confirmation listing all lenses included in sale
risks.if_unproven: priced as TTArtisan lens only, no native Nikkor glass

risks.risk: Missing memory card, strap, or USB cable
risks.proof: Photo of full accessory set laid out including cables/card
risks.if_unproven: priced as body + lens + battery/charger only, no extras

risks.proof: Screenshot of battery info menu showing charge cycles
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown battery health, assume aged

risks.risk: Hidden physical damage (dents, corrosion) outside photographed angles
risks.proof: Additional photos from side, bottom, and mount area close-up
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming possible cosmetic damage not disclosed

risks.risk: No proof of original purchase or authenticity
risks.proof: Photo of original box, receipt, or warranty card

proof_requests: Video of camera powering on and autofocus/shutter operating
Screenshot of shutter count and battery cycle count from menu
Close-up photos of lens glass (front/rear elements)
Photo of all included accessories (card, cables, strap, box)
Additional body angle photos (sides, bottom, lens mount) for damage check
response.reason: Identity of the Nikon Zfc with TTArtisan lens is confirmed by the witness, so it can be priced at worst case for unverified condition, missing kit lens, and unconfirmed functional/battery status.
